45700.grammar: fem, agent, from pāyanta, caus, trans (+acc)

examples.text: so na kumbhimukhā paṭiggaṇhāmi, na kaḷopimukhā paṭiggaṇhāmi, na eḷakam'antaraṃ, na daṇḍam'antaraṃ, na musalam'antaraṃ, na dvinnaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ, na gabbhiniyā, na pāyantiyā, na puris'antaragatāya, na saṅkittīsu
dissanti kho pana, assalāyana, brāhmaṇānaṃ brāhmaṇiyo utuniyo'pi gabbhiniyo'pi vijāyamānā'pi pāyamānā'pi.
te na kumbhimukhā paṭiggaṇhanti na kaḷopimukhā paṭiggaṇhanti na eḷakam'antaraṃ na daṇḍam'antaraṃ na musalam'antaraṃ na dvinnaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ na gabbhiniyā na pāyamānāya na puris'antaragatāya
atha kho kasibhāradvājo brāhmaṇo mahatiyā kaṃsapātiyā pāyasaṃ vaḍḍhetvā bhagavato upanāmesi, bhuñjatu bhavaṃ gotamo pāyasaṃ.

ye'pi te, mahārāja, bhikkhū arahanto khīṇ'āsavā vusitavanto katakaraṇīyā ohitabhārā anuppattasadatthā parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojanā samma'd'aññāvimuttā, tesaṃ'p'āyaṃ kāyo bhedanadhammo nikkhepanadhammo'ti.

45707.meaning1: name of a group of nāgas
45707.construction:
pa + √yaj > yag > yāg + *a + ā
pāyāga + ā
45707.commentary: (DNa) supaṇṇehi'pi anuddharaṇīyā mahesakkhanāgā pāyāgā saha ñātibhī'ti payāgatitthavāsino ca saha ñātisaṅghena āgatā.

examples.text: ath'āguṃ nāgasā nāgā, vesālā sahatacchakā, kambal'assatarā āguṃ, pāyāgā saha ñātibhi.

45709.meaning1: caused to set out; made begin the journey
45709.meaning2: caused to set out; made begin the journey

examples.text: ekato pañca sakaṭasatāni, ekato pañca sakaṭasatāni. eko satthavāho bahuṃ tiṇañ'ca kaṭṭhañ'ca udakañ'ca āropetvā satthaṃ pāyāpesi.
atha kho kasibhāradvājo brāhmaṇo mahatiyā kaṃsapātiyā pāyāsaṃ vaḍḍhetvā bhagavato upanāmesi, bhuñjatu bhavaṃ gotamo pāyāsaṃ.
ajapālarukkhamūlasmiṃ, nisīditvā tathāgato, pāyāsaṃ paggayha, nerañjaram'upehiti.

45711.meaning1: went out; set out; started off

examples.text: atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo bhadraṃ yānaṃ abhiruhitvā bhadrehi bhadrehi yānehi nagarakamhā niyyāsi mahaccā rāj'ānubhāvena. yena ārāmo tena pāyāsi. yāvatikā yānassa bhūmi yānena gantvā yānā paccorohitvā pattiko'va ārāmaṃ pāvisi.
tena kho pana samayena pāyāsi rājañño setabyaṃ ajjhāvasati satt'ussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭh'odakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rājabhoggaṃ raññā pasenadinā kosalena dinnaṃ rājadāyaṃ brahmadeyyaṃ.
pāyāsidevaputto ca ekadivasaṃ vāṇijakānaṃ dassetvā attano katakammaṃ kathesī'ti.

45714.meaning1: case of Pāyāsi the young nobleman

45717.meaning1: went out; set out; started off (to)
45717.commentary: (JAa) pāyiṃsū'ti idāni appamattā bhaveyyāthā'ti kusanar'indena ovaditā agamaṃsu.

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, khaṇḍo ca rājaputto tisso ca purohitaputto bhaddāni bhaddāni yānāni yojāpetvā bhaddaṃ bhaddaṃ yānaṃ abhiruhitvā bhaddehi bhaddehi yānehi bandhumatiyā rājadhāniyā niyyiṃsu. yena khemo migadāyo tena pāyiṃsu.
pīṇitā tena lābhena, tuṭṭhā sīhassare kuse, sakaraṭṭhāni pāyiṃsu, khattiyā satta tāva'd'e.

45718.meaning1: (of a metal) quenched; hardened in water
45718.notes: refers to the metallurgical process of quenching used to harden steel.

45720.commentary: (JAa) aḍḍharatt'āpapāyin'ti purimayāmaṃ atikkamitvā majjhimayāme araññato āgamma pānīyassa pivanato aḍḍharatte āpaṃ pivatī'ti aḍḍharatt'āpapāyī. taṃ aḍḍharatte apāyin'ti attho.

examples.text: migaṃ tipallattham'anekamāyaṃ, aṭṭhakkhuraṃ aḍḍharatt'āpapāyiṃ, ekena sotena cham'āssasanto, chahi kalāhi'tibhoti bhāgineyyo'ti.
atha kho, bhikkhave, bandhumā rājā vipassissa kumārassa dhātiyo upaṭṭhāpesi. aññā khīraṃ pāyenti, aññā nhāpenti, aññā dhārenti, aññā aṅkena pariharanti.
yathā, mahārāja, koci'd'eva puriso visaṃ abhisaṅkharitvā attanā ca piveyya, pare ca pāyeyya, so attanā'pi dukkhito bhaveyya, pare'pi dukkhitā bhaveyyuṃ.

45722.meaning1: having made drink; having caused to drink; having got drunk

examples.text: sakko devarājā, kiṃ no sādhāraṇena rajjenā'ti asure dibbapānaṃ pāyetvā matte samāne pādesu gāhāpetvā sinerupabbatapāde khipāpesi. te asurabhavanam'eva sampāpuṇiṃsu.
āpādikā'ti saṃvaḍḍhikā, tumhākaṃ hatthapādesu hatthapādakiccaṃ asādhentesu hatthe ca pāde ca vaḍḍhetvā paṭijaggikā'ti attho. posikā'ti divasassa dve tayo vāre nhāpetvā bhojetvā pāyetvā tumhe posesi.

45723.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of pāya

45725.commentary: (MNa) thaññaṃ pāyesī'ti nandakumāro kira bodhisattato katip'āhen'eva daharo, tasmiṃ jāte mahāpajāpati attano puttaṃ dhātīnaṃ datvā sayaṃ bodhisattassa dhātikiccaṃ sādhayamānā attano thaññaṃ pāyesi. taṃ sandhāya thero evam'āha.

examples.text: bah'ūpakārā, bhante, mahāpajāpati gotamī bhagavato mātucchā āpādikā posikā khīrassa dāyikā, bhagavantaṃ janettiyā kālaṅ'katāya thaññaṃ pāyesi. bhagavā'pi, bhante, bah'ūpakāro mahāpajāpatiyā gotamiyā.

45726.meaning1: far side; far shore; bank on the other side (of)

examples.text: oraṃ samuddassa atittarūpo, pāraṃ samuddassa'pi patthayetha, rājā ca aññe ca bahū manussā, avītataṇhā maraṇaṃ upenti, ūnā'va hutvāna jahanti dehaṃ, kāmehi lokamhi na hatthi titti.
anāpatti na has'ādhippāyo, sati karaṇīye udakaṃ otaritvā nimujjati vā ummujjati vā palavati vā, pāraṃ gacchanto nimujjati vā ummujjati vā palavati vā, āpadāsu, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

45728.meaning1: who has gone beyond; who has crossed over; who has mastered; who thoroughly knows
45728.commentary: (SNa) bhavattha jātimaraṇassa pāragā'ti jātimaraṇānaṃ pāraṃ nibbānaṃ gamakā hotha.

examples.text: evaṃ mano chassu yadā subhāvito, phuṭṭhassa cittaṃ na vikampate kvaci, te rāgadose abhibhuyya bhikkhavo, bhavattha jātimaraṇassa pāragā'ti.

45729.meaning1: far side of the Ganges river
45729.commentary: (SNa) pāragaṅgāyā'ti dvīsu pādesu gahetvā taṃ āviñchetvā yathā na pun'āgacchasi, evaṃ pāraṃ vā gaṅgāya khipissāmī'ti vadati.

examples.text: sace me na byākarissasi, cittaṃ vā te khipissāmi, hadayaṃ vā te phālessāmi, pādesu vā gahetvā pāragaṅgāya khipissāmī'ti.

45730.meaning1: gone beyond; reached the far shore; crossed over; epithet of an arahant
45730.meaning2: who has gone to the end or the other shore
45730.commentary: (ANa) pāragato'ti chah'ākārehi pāragato. idha khīṇ'āsavo'va kathito. (ITIa) pāraṃ nibbānaṃ gato'ti pāragato.

examples.text: paroparā yassa samecca dhammā, vidhūpitā atthagatā na santi, sa ve muni vusitabrahmacariyo, lok'antagū pāragato'ti vuccatī'ti.
yo'maṃ palipathaṃ duggaṃ, saṃsāraṃ moham'accagā, tiṇṇo pāragato jhāyī, anejo akathaṃkathī, anupādāya nibbuto, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

45731.meaning1: seeking salvation; who is looking for the beyond
45731.meaning2: looking for the final end or the other shore

examples.text: hananti bhogā dummedhaṃ, no ca pāragavesino, bhogataṇhāya dummedho, hanti aññ'eva attanaṃ.
alattakakatā pādā, mukhaṃ cuṇṇakamakkhitaṃ, alaṃ bālassa mohāya, no ca pāragavesino.

45732.meaning1: seeking the far shore; wanting to cross to the other side
45732.meaning2: seeking the far shore; wanting to cross to the other side

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, vāseṭṭha, ayaṃ aciravatī nadī pūrā udakassa samatittikā kākapeyyā. atha puriso āgaccheyya pār'atthiko pāragavesī pāragāmī pāraṃ taritu'kāmo. so orime tīre ṭhito pārimaṃ tīraṃ avheyya, ehi pār'āpāraṃ, ehi pār'āpāran'ti.

45733.meaning1: name of a group of deities

examples.text: ath'āguṃ harayo devā, ye ca lohitavāsino, pāragā mahāpāragā, āguṃ devā yasassino, das'ete dasadhā kāyā, sabbe nānattavaṇṇino.

45734.meaning1: who crosses over; who goes to the other shore

examples.text: appakā te manussesu, ye janā pāragāmino, ath'āyaṃ itarā pajā, tīram'ev'ānudhāvati.

45735.meaning1: leading to the far shore; going across
45735.meaning2: going to the far shore; travelling across

examples.text: pārañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi pāragāmiñ'ca maggaṃ. taṃ suṇātha.

45736.meaning1: who has gone beyond; who has crossed over

examples.text: yaṃ manussā namassanti, sabbadhammāna pāraguṃ, devā'pi taṃ namassanti, iti me arahato sutaṃ.
muñca pure muñca pacchato, majjhe muñca bhavassa pāragū, sabbattha vimuttamānaso, na punaṃ jātijaraṃ upehisi.

45737.meaning1: master (of); who is profoundly learned (in); who is fully conversant (with)
45737.meaningLit: who has gone to the far side
45737.commentary: (MNa) pāragū sabbadhammānan'ti sabbesaṃ lokiyalok'uttaradhammānaṃ abhiññāya pāraṃ gato, sabbadhamme abhijānitvā ṭhito'ti attho. pāragū'ti vā ettāvatā pariññāpāragū pañcannaṃ khandhānaṃ, pahānapāragū sabbakilesānaṃ, bhāvanāpāragū catunnaṃ maggānaṃ, sacchikiriyāpāragū nirodhassa, samāpattipāragū sabbasamāpattīnan'ti ayam'attho vutto.

examples.text: tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ, padako, veyyākaraṇo, lok'āyata-mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo.
cittaṃ visuddhaṃ jānāti, muttaṃ rāgehi sabbaso. pahīnajātimaraṇo, brahmacariyassa kevalī, pāragū sabbadhammānaṃ, buddho tādī pavuccatī'ti.

45738.meaning1: reached the other shore; gone across safely; gone beyond; epithet of an arahant

examples.text: yattha kāmā nirujjhanti, ye ca kāme nirodhetvā nirodhetvā viharanti, addhā te āyasmanto nicchātā nibbutā tiṇṇā pāraṅ'gatā tadaṅgenā'ti vadāmi
tassa purisassa uttiṇṇassa pāraṅ'gatassa evam'assa, bahukāro kho me ayaṃ kullo, im'āhaṃ kullaṃ nissāya hatthehi ca pādehi ca vāyamamāno sotthinā pāraṃ uttiṇṇo.

45739.meaning1: going to the other shore; crossing safely; (comm) going to Nibbāna
45739.commentary: (SNa) hīn'attarūpā na pāraṃ gamā te'ti hīn'attasabhāvā te nibbānaṅgamā na honti.

examples.text: pañcavedā sataṃ samaṃ, tapassī brāhmaṇā caraṃ, cittañ'ca nesaṃ na sammā vimuttaṃ, hīn'attharūpā na pāraṅ'gamā te.
taṇh'ādhipannā vatasīlabaddhā, lūkhaṃ tapaṃ vassasataṃ carantā, cittañ'ca nesaṃ na sammā vimuttaṃ, hīn'attharūpā na pāraṅ'gamā te.

45740.meaningLit: discourse on going to the other shore

45741.meaningLit: discourse on going to the other shore

examples.text: pāṇā sūriyūpamā dve, gilānā apare tayo, pāraṅ'gāmī viraddho ca, ariyo nibbidāya cā'ti.

45743.meaning1: seeking the far shore; wanting to cross
45743.meaning2: seeking the far shore; wanting to cross

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, vāseṭṭha, ayaṃ aciravatī nadī pūrā udakassa samatittikā kākapeyyā. atha puriso āgaccheyya pār'atthiko pāragavesī pāragāmī pāraṃ taritu'kāmo. so orime tīre ṭhito pārimaṃ tīraṃ avheyya, ehi pār'āpāraṃ, ehi pār'āpāran'ti.

45745.meaning1: seeing the far shore; (comm) seeing Nibbāna
45745.commentary: (SNa) apāradassī'ti pāraṃ vuccati nibbānaṃ, taṃ na passati.

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako na rūpabandhanabaddho, na santarabāhirabandhanabaddho, tīradassī, pāradassī, parimutto so dukkhasmā'ti vadāmi.

dīgharattaṃ vo, bhikkhave, corā pāripanthikāti gahetvā sīsacchinnānaṃ lohitaṃ passannaṃ paggharitaṃ. dīgharattaṃ vo, bhikkhave, corā pāradārikā'ti gahetvā sīsacchinnānaṃ lohitaṃ passannaṃ paggharitaṃ, na tv'eva catūsu mahāsamuddesu udakaṃ. taṃ kissa hetu?

45749.construction:
para > pāra + ma + *ī + tā
pāramī + tā

examples.text: paññāpāramitaṃ patto, mahābuddhi mahāmati, ajaḷo jaḷasamāno, sadā carati nibbuto.
tath'eva tvam'pi ahitahite, samaṃ mettāya bhāvaya, mettāpāramitaṃ gantvā, sambodhiṃ pāpuṇissasī'ti.

45750.meaning1: reached perfection; attained the ultimate state

examples.text: abhiññāpāramippatto, sotadhātu visodhitā, tevijjo iddhipatto'mhi, cetopariyakovido.

sāriputtam'eva taṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya, vasippatto pāramippatto ariyasmiṃ sīlasmiṃ, vasippatto pāramippatto ariyasmiṃ samādhismiṃ, vasippatto pāramippatto ariyāya paññāya, vasippatto pāramippatto ariyāya vimuttiyā'ti.

45751.meaning1: fulfilment; perfection; transcendental virtue; ultimate state

examples.text: vicinanto tadā dakkhiṃ, dutiyaṃ sīlapāramiṃ, pubbakehi mah'esīhi, āsevitanisevitaṃ.
ayya sumedhatāpasa, porāṇakabodhisattānaṃ pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā, pāramiyo vicinissāmā'ti nisinnakāle yāni pubbanimittāni nāma paññāyanti, tāni sabbāni'pi ajja pātubhūtāni

45752.meaning1: goes to the far shore; crosses over

examples.text: ye ca kho sammadakkhāte, dhamme dhamm'ānuvattino, te janā pāram'essanti, maccudheyyaṃ suduttaraṃ.

45754.meaning2: connected with the other world or the future birth

45756.grammar: ind, prep, acc sg of pāra

examples.text: paṭipatti paṭipanno ca, viraddhañ'ca pāraṃgamā, sāmaññena ca dve vuttā, brahmaññā apare duve, brahmacariyena dve vuttā, vaggo tena pavuccatī'ti.

45758.meaning2: who has committed the gravest transgression of the rules for Bhikkhu
45758.commentary: (VIN 6.8.5) pārājikan'ti yaṃ vuttaṃ, taṃ suṇohi yathātathaṃ, cuto paraddho bhaṭṭho ca, saddhammā hi niraṅkato, saṃvāso'pi tahiṃ n'atthi, ten'etaṃ iti vuccati. (VINa) pārājiko'ti parājito, parājayaṃ āpanno.
45758.notes: Indic Languages in Brill's Encyclopedia of Buddhism: 'Similarly, the correct derivation and original meaning of the legal technical term pārājika based on the Vedic verb parā + aj-, 'to drive away,' probably originally belonging to the vocabulary of cattle keepers and therefore unknown to the Buddhist tradition, which sought a connection to parā + ji-, 'to defeat' (pārājika > pārājayika), were found out by one of the pioneers of Western Buddhist studies, E. Burnouf, as early as 1844 and confirmed again by H. Smith in 1966 (von Hinüber, 1988, 3).' Nyanatusita notes the Jain equivalent is pārañcika, from parāñcin 'not returning'.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno sikkhaṃ appaccakkhāya dubbalyaṃ anāvikatvā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭiseveyya, antamaso tiracchānagatāya'pi, pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.
uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto cattāro pārājikā dhammā. yesaṃ bhikkhu aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā āpajjitvā na labhati bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ saṃvāsaṃ yathā pure, tathā pacchā, pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.

45759.commentary: (VIN 6.8.5) pārājikan'ti yaṃ vuttaṃ, taṃ suṇohi yathātathaṃ, cuto paraddho bhaṭṭho ca, saddhammā hi niraṅkato, saṃvāso'pi tahiṃ n'atthi, ten'etaṃ iti vuccati. (VINa) pārājiko'ti parājito, parājayaṃ āpanno.
45759.notes: Indic Languages in Brill's Encyclopedia of Buddhism: 'Similarly, the correct derivation and original meaning of the legal technical term pārājika based on the Vedic verb parā + aj-, 'to drive away,' probably originally belonging to the vocabulary of cattle keepers and therefore unknown to the Buddhist tradition, which sought a connection to parā + ji-, 'to defeat' (pārājika > pārājayika), were found out by one of the pioneers of Western Buddhist studies, E. Burnouf, as early as 1844 and confirmed again by H. Smith in 1966 (von Hinüber, 1988, 3).' Nyanatusita notes the Jain equivalent is pārañcika, from parāñcin 'not returning'.

examples.text: tatr'ime cattāro pārājikā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto cattāro pārājikā dhammā. yesaṃ bhikkhu aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā āpajjitvā na labhati bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ saṃvāsaṃ yathā pure, tathā pacchā, pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.

45760.meaning1: (vinaya) offence involving defeat; transgression requiring expulsion
45760.commentary: (VIN 6.8.5) pārājikan'ti yaṃ vuttaṃ, taṃ suṇohi yathātathaṃ, cuto paraddho bhaṭṭho ca, saddhammā hi niraṅkato, saṃvāso'pi tahiṃ n'atthi, ten'etaṃ iti vuccati. (VINa) pārājiko'ti parājito, parājayaṃ āpanno.
45760.notes: Indic Languages in Brill's Encyclopedia of Buddhism: 'Similarly, the correct derivation and original meaning of the legal technical term pārājika based on the Vedic verb parā + aj-, 'to drive away,' probably originally belonging to the vocabulary of cattle keepers and therefore unknown to the Buddhist tradition, which sought a connection to parā + ji-, 'to defeat' (pārājika > pārājayika), were found out by one of the pioneers of Western Buddhist studies, E. Burnouf, as early as 1844 and confirmed again by H. Smith in 1966 (von Hinüber, 1988, 3).' Nyanatusita notes the Jain equivalent is pārañcika, from parāñcin 'not returning'.

examples.text: duṭṭhullā nāma āpatti cattāri ca pārājikāni terasa ca saṅgh'ādisesā.

45762.meaningLit: canonical text of offences involving defeat

examples.text: [ettha labheyy'āhaṃ… upasampadaṃ'ti vākyadvayaṃ sabbesu'pi mūlapotthakesu dissati, pārājikapāḷiyaṃ pana sudinnabhāṇavāre etaṃ n'atthi. pabbājetu maṃ bhagavā'ti idaṃ pana vākyaṃ marammapotthake y'eva dissati, pārājikapāḷiyañ'ca tadeva atthi]

45763.meaning1: (vinaya) nearly involving defeat; closely related to expulsion
45763.commentary: (VINa) pārājikasāmantaṃ vā'ti ettha methunadhamme pārājikasāmantaṃ nāma dukkaṭaṃ hoti. adinn'ādān'ādīsu thull'accayaṃ.

examples.text: kathañ'c'ānanda, sativinayo hoti? idh'ānanda, bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ evarūpāya garukāya āpattiyā codenti pārājikena vā pārājikasāmantena vā, sarat'āyasmā evarūpiṃ garukaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitā pārājikaṃ vā pārājikasāmantaṃ vā'ti?
manussaviggahapārājik'āpatti uttarimanussadhammapārājik'āpattiyā methunadhammapārājik'āpattiyā adinn'ādānapārājik'āpattiyā aññabhāgiyā.

45765.notes: Theragāthā verse 116 (TH1.116, TH116) is attributed to him.

45769.meaning1: far and near shore; world and self; other world and this world; thither and hither; duality; (comm) internal and external sense fields
45769.commentary: (DHPa) pāran'ti ajjhattikāni cha āyatanāni. apāran'ti bāhirāni cha āyatanāni. pār'āpāran'ti tadubhayaṃ.

examples.text: yassa pāraṃ apāraṃ vā, pār'āpāraṃ na vijjati, vītaddaraṃ visaṃyuttaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

45770.meaning1: far shore (come to) the near shore!
45770.commentary: (DNa) ehi pār'āpāran'ti ambho pāra apāraṃ ehi, atha maṃ sahasā'va gahetvā gamissasi, atthi me accāyikakamman'ti attho.

examples.text: atha puriso āgaccheyya pār'atthiko pāragavesī pāragāmī pāraṃ taritu'kāmo. so orime tīre ṭhito pārimaṃ tīraṃ avheyya, ehi pār'āpāraṃ, ehi pār'āpāran'ti.

45771.meaning1: Way to the Far Shore; Way to the Beyond; last chapter of the Sutta Nipāta (SNP 56, KN5.56)

examples.text: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati. tatra kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ āmantesi, vuttam'idaṃ, sāriputta, pārāyaṇe ajitapañhe

45772.meaning1: Way to the Far Shore; Way to the Beyond; last chapter of the Sutta Nipāta

examples.text: idañ'ca pana m'etaṃ, bhikkhave, sandhāya bhāsitaṃ pārāyane puṇṇakapañhe.

tena kho pana samayena sambahulānaṃ therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānaṃ maṇḍalamāḷe sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayam'antarākathā udapādi, vuttam'idaṃ, āvuso, bhagavatā pārāyane metteyyapañhe.

45775.meaning1: ?? meeting regarding the Way to the Far Shore ?? scripture regarding the Way to the Far Shore

examples.text: atha kho uttaro māṇavo pārāsariy'antevāsī yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
aññathā kho, ānanda, deseti pārāsiviyo brāhmaṇo sāvakānaṃ indriyabhāvanaṃ, aññathā ca pan'ānanda, ariyassa vinaye anuttarā indriyabhāvanā hotī'ti.

andho hi, uttara, cakkhunā rūpaṃ na passati, badhiro sotena saddaṃ na suṇātī'ti. evaṃ vutte, uttaro māṇavo pārāsiviy'antevāsī tuṇhībhūto maṅkubhūto pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāno nisīdi.

45782.commentary: (DNt) pārāvatapakkhivaṇṇānī'ti pārāvatassa nāma pakkhino vaṇṇāni. pārāvatapakkhavaṇṇānī'ti pāṭho, pārāvatasakuṇassa pattavaṇṇānī'ti attho.

examples.text: yā puṇṇamāse migamandalocanā, upāvisi puṇḍarīkattac'aṅgī, dve puṇṇamāyo tadahū amaññ'ahaṃ, disvāna pārāvatarattavāsiniṃ.
kāpotakānī'ti kapotavaṇṇāni, pārāvatapakkhavaṇṇānī'ti attho.

45784.meaning2: state of being adorned; being dressed up; posing
45784.construction:
pari + √kar > khar + ta + iya
parikkhatta + iya

examples.text: etadaggaṃ bhagini pāricariyānaṃ yā mādisaṃ sīlavantaṃ kalyāṇadhammaṃ brahmacāriṃ etena dhammena paricareyyā'ti methun'upasaṃhitena, saṅgh'ādiseso.
tāya naṃ pāricariyāya, mātāpitūsu paṇḍitā, idh'eva naṃ pasaṃsanti, pecca sagge pamodatī'ti.

45786.meaning1: excellence of attending; best kind of service
45786.commentary: (DNa) khattiy'ādīnaṃ pāricariyā na pāricariy'ānuttariyaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ pana ratanānaṃ pāricariyā pāricariy'ānuttariyaṃ nāma.

examples.text: cha anuttariyāni, dassan'ānuttariyaṃ, savan'ānuttariyaṃ, lābh'ānuttariyaṃ, sikkh'ānuttariyaṃ, pāricariy'ānuttariyaṃ, anussat'ānuttariyaṃ.

45787.meaning1: because of attending (to); because of associating (with someone)

examples.text: yaṃ hi'ssa, brāhmaṇa, paricarato pāricariyāhetu pāpiyo assa na seyyo, n'āhaṃ taṃ paricaritabban'ti vadāmi, yañ'ca khv'āssa, brāhmaṇa, paricarato pāricariyāhetu seyyo assa na pāpiyo tam'ahaṃ paricaritabban'ti vadāmi.

45789.commentary: (VVa) pāricchattake koviḷāre'ti pāricchattakanāmake koviḷārapupphe ādāya dibbamālaṃ ganthamānā'ti yojanā.

examples.text: pāricchattake koviḷāre, ramaṇīye manorame, dibbamālaṃ ganthamānā, gāyantī sampamodasi.
yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, āvuso, dhāresi bhaddekarattiyo gāthā'ti? ekam'idaṃ, bhikkhu, samayaṃ bhagavā devesu tāvatiṃsesu viharati pāricchattakamūle paṇḍukambalasilāyaṃ.

45794.meaning1: name of a type of tree; Bauhinia variegata
45794.commentary: (NIDD2) sañchannapatto yathā pārichattako'ti yathā so pārichattako koviḷāro bahalapattapalāso sandacchāyo, evam'eva so paccekasambuddho paripuṇṇapattacīvaradharo'ti, sañchannapatto yathā pārichattako.

examples.text: hirīsūriyaṃ upamā, dhammaññū pārichattakaṃ, sakkaccaṃ bhāvanā aggi, sunetta-arakena cā'ti.
cattār'imāni, bho raṭṭhapāla, pārijuññāni yehi pārijuññehi samannāgatā idh'ekacce kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti.

45798.commentary: (VINt) pāripūr'atthan'ti pāripūri attho yassā'ti viggaho. kiriyāvisesanaṃ, pāripūrippayojanaṃ katvā'ti attho.

examples.text: ūnassa pāripūriyā'ti ūnassa pāripūr'atthāya.
tassa papaṭikā'pi pāripūriṃ gacchati taco'pi pheggu'pi sāro'pi pāripūriṃ gacchati
aṭṭh'ime, bhikkhave, hetū aṭṭha paccayā ādibrahmacariyikāya paññāya appaṭiladdhāya paṭilābhāya, paṭiladdhāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattanti. katame aṭṭha?
